Package gov.Lab2

Class Location

java.lang.Object
gov.Lab2.Location
Direct Known Subclasses:
Airport, City, Restaurant
public abstract sealed class Location extends Object permits City, Airport, Restaurant
Abstract sealed base class representing a geographic location on a 2D map.

Only City, Airport, and Restaurant are permitted subclasses. Each location has an (x, y) coordinate pair and a name.
